title: bromus squarrosus var. contortus
intro: Bromus squarrosus var. contortus, commonly known as Bristle Bent or Twisted Bristle Bent, is a plant species within the grass family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bromus squarrosus var. contortus are attributed to its ability to relieve coughs and congestion, as well as its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
